Jobs watch: weaker hiring can cut both ways for US stocks

https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/jobs-watch-weaker-hiring-can-cut…

Source: BLS.

A weak jobs headline can ease rate pressure and weaken the earnings outlook at the same time.

The S&P 500 needs both sides of that story.

Watch: A falling yield by itself will not distinguish relief about rates from worry about growth.
